cohort: 178 female nurses and midwives in North Gondar Zone, Northwest Ethiopia
finding: Despite adequate knowledge on breastfeeding, the exclusive breastfeeding rate among nurses and midwives in North Gondar Zone, Northwest Ethiopia was low (35.9%), with older age, rural residence, being a midwife, vaginal delivery, multiparity, and resuming work after 3 months being independently associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
